consequence.statement: Tools and CLI commands that parse `.status.resources[].health` directly will not find persisted health status; they must use the Argo CD CLI or API instead to retrieve health information.
consequence.remediation: Update any custom tooling or scripts parsing `.status.resources[].health` to use the Argo CD CLI or API for health status queries. Alternatively, set `controller.resource.health.persist: true` in the `argocd-cmd-params-cm.yaml` ConfigMap to restore the previous behavior.

original.statement: The health status is no longer persisted in the Application CR's `/status` by default in 3.0.0; it is stored externally instead, and can be reverted by setting `controller.resource.health.persist` to `true` in the `argocd-cmd-params-cm.yaml` ConfigMap.

decision.reason: [ev-5616a3c7f69a] says per-object health is no longer persisted under `/status` in the Application CR by default but stored externally, and `controller.resource.health.persist: true` in argocd-cmd-params-cm restores it. Argo CD keeps working; the release text only says external tools parsing `.status.resources[].health` must switch to the argocd CLI/API. That makes this a changed default that still works, so behavior-change (review) fits and a mandatory kind would over-claim. The proposed statement, remediation and medium severity match the evidence.
